configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Nen cho moi preset: Ninja + MSVC (goi trong ham vcvarsall cua Tools/build/build.cmd hoac prompt VS 2022). Cac preset KHONG the hardcode duong dan cmake/ninja cua BuildTools o day; dung 'cmake --preset <ten>' tu prompt da co MSVC. Tree dat ben ngoai Build/cmake/<name> de khong de nhau.

configurePresets.name: client-x64
configurePresets.description: Toan bo chuoi phu thu cua client, khong viewer/test/chan doan. Thu tu = CYS_ALL_COMPONENTS (thứ tự phụ thuộc). Chi tiết: Docs/12-CAU-HINH-BUILD-CLIENT_vi.md.

configurePresets.name: game-exe-x64
configurePresets.displayName: Game.exe x64 Release (nhanh, dung tree coord-x64 cu)
configurePresets.description: Bang 'build.cmd x64 coord-x64 Release "" cys_wxclient'. LUU Y: Game.exe nap Render/UI luc chay, build rieng target nay khong dung nghia DLL render/UI da duoc dung lai - muon chac dung client-x64 hoac CI. Plan build: cmake --build --preset game-exe-x64 --target cys_wxclient

configurePresets.name: client-x64-debug
configurePresets.description: Cung chuoi client-x64 nhung /MDd + khong NDEBUG. Plan build: cmake --build --preset client-x64-debug

configurePresets.name: all-x64
configurePresets.displayName: Toan cay x64 Release (như ci.ps1: moi component)
configurePresets.description: Khong dat CYS_COMPONENTS => mac dinh = CYS_ALL_COMPONENTS (33). Gom ca viewer, test app, d3d9trace; stage.ps1 se chep het bin/ nen chi dung khi CI/kien toan. Plan build: cmake --build --preset all-x64
